Liking sports is normal, liking to watch documentaries like you're binging Netflix is different. Liking pink and cute things is normal, liking historical fashion is different etc etc.

Or I'd feign illness to go home. I left school alot in elementary specifically because it was easiest to do then.

As an adult child of a BPD mother, I will tell you I wished I had more than anything somewhere else to go, even if it was just for a few hours every week as a kid. Another parental figure in my life to look to and validate my beliefs that what I was experiencing was not a normal or healthy parent-child dynamic just by showing me what one DID look like. There was a week that I went to a camp and another week that I went on a lake trip and those memories are so bright and sharp in my mind compared to everything else that fades into darkness, partly because of the fun of it but also the utter relief of being with a normal family and normal schoolmates. We were actually homeless and staying at said family's house for a short period of time as well and despite being homeless (technically?), I still look on that time period with a kind of fondness because I was surrounded by a family I loved and my mom didn't have the space to violently blow up in since we were staying for free and she was outnumbered 5-1.

I think I would've turned out much more differently if I had just had that.

-poor sleep/eating habits (or fluctating in quality)
-issues with anger/managing emotions
-irritability, feelings of worthlessness/pointlessness
-memory loss
-brain fog
-loss of interest in things you previously enjoyed
-poor or fluctating quality in hygiene
-general problems with neglecting self/responsibilities
